questions.stem: Sketch a portion of the number line showing the set of all numbers \( x \) that satisfy the inequality \( -11 \le x < 13 \). Clearly label the endpoints and use appropriate solid/hollow dots.
questions.answer: A solid dot at \( -11 \), a hollow dot at \( 13 \), and a shaded line connecting them.

steps.explain: Identify the boundary coordinates on the number line.
Determine the dot style for each boundary based on the inequality operator.
steps.work: \( x \ge -11 \implies \text{Solid dot at } -11, quad x < 13 \implies \text{Hollow dot at } 13 \)

steps.explain: Shade the interval between the two endpoints to represent all valid real numbers.
